description: Share a fact you verified on a public web page during this task, so the next agent doesn't have to look it up. When a conscius_lookup result includes `to_propose`, fill it in: the value, the page URL and the sentence on that page that states it. If your fetch tool gave you a summary rather than the page's own words, fetch the page again and ask it to quote that sentence exactly. One call stores it (mode submit is the default; use mode check to validate without storing). Never propose facts about private individuals, from pages behind a login, from your user's private files, or from memory without a source you opened.

origins.description: Optional: where each field's content came from, as {"value": "page", "subject": "conscius"}: typed (you wrote it), page (copied from the source page; it must then appear in supporting_text), conscius (copied from a Conscius answer, such as an id).

paid_source.description: true if you paid to read the page (HTTP 402, a paywall, a pay-per-use offer), its license terms forbid AI reuse, or it's a licensed work (from conscius_works or another licensed guide). A paid page can't be a claim's source: cite a free page that states the fact instead.

plan.description: The plan, tier, auth mode, mode or region the value holds for, as the page names it ("Pro", "Free tier", "authenticated", "test mode", "us-east-1"); "all plans" if the page says so. Put it here, not in the property or the value. Leave it out when the value doesn't depend on one.

property.description: What the fact says about it: plain words or a Wikidata property ID ("latest stable version", "P348").

source_url.description: The public page where you read the fact.

subject.description: The thing the fact is about: a name or Wikidata ID.

supporting_text.description: The sentence on the page that states the fact, copied exactly. Used for checking, then discarded.

valid_from.description: When the value became true (YYYY-MM-DD), if the page says.

value.description: The value, short: a number with unit, a date (YYYY-MM-DD), a name, or a short phrase.

wanted_item.description: The wanted list item this claim answers (wl_…, from conscius_wanted), if any.

mode.description: submit (default) stores the claims unless they have problems; check validates and suggests IDs without storing.

name: conscius_propose
title: Propose facts
